purpose: Define the required real-process evidence before the two-relay reflection fixture can be marked executable.

seed.recipient: relay A actor or recognized follower collection

required_observations: Every remote actor and canonical-object GET is HTTP signed.
Every cross-relay inbox POST is counted by destination and activity ID.
Redis ready, delayed, claimed, retry, and retained-activity state is recorded for both relays.
The probe has a hard POST threshold that stops a runaway reflection cycle.
The report distinguishes delivery retries from newly generated relay Announce activities.
The report preserves logs and exact process configuration outside the repository.
promotion_rule: The command is a required passing process invariant. Any classification other than no_reflection_observed, any generated non-seed cross-relay POST, invalid signature, missing canonical marker, or final queue backlog fails validation.
runtime_invariants: The relay that supplied a referenced Announce is excluded from fan-out.
The fetched canonical activity ID is reserved atomically in Redis before a new relay Announce is admitted.
A duplicate canonical reference is acknowledged without minting a new relay Announce ID.
Canonical reservation keys contain only a SHA-256 digest and expire with the retained activity horizon.
Known queue-admission failure releases the canonical reservation so a later retry can proceed.
